base_properties.human_readable: Bitcoin Pragmatic Synthesis: Frozen Monetary Kernel with Delegated Innovation Layers

omegas.question: Where exactly does the kernel boundary sit — does a 'kernel violation' cover only monetary parameters (supply cap, issuance schedule), or also consensus mechanics and scripting capability?
omegas.resolution_mechanism: Longitudinal audit of maintainer accept/reject decisions and their articulated criteria across successive upgrade proposals (SegWit, Taproot, covenants, drivechains): track whether the refused set expands from monetary-parameter changes into capability changes.
omegas.impact: A narrow boundary leaves headroom for base-layer evolution and keeps the arrangement genuinely provisional; a widening boundary extends the freeze beyond monetary policy and pushes practice toward de facto maximalism without its candor.
omegas.description: Contestable location of the frozen-kernel boundary.

omegas.question: Is the implied sunset real — does a practicable pathway exist by which the frozen base could be amended if evidence ever demanded it, or has the moratorium silently converted into permanent structure?
omegas.resolution_mechanism: Observe whether any substantively supported but non-unanimous base-layer proposal can complete activation within a decade; the Taproot activation (near-unanimous support, roughly three years of signaling) calibrates the machinery's tolerance for dissent.
omegas.impact: If no dissenting-but-supported change can pass, the transitional justification has lapsed and the arrangement operates as a permanent freeze — reclassification pressure away from scaffold; if passage remains possible, the moratorium is live and the sunset clause is honest.
omegas.description: Whether the provisional-freeze framing retains a working reversal pathway.

omegas.question: This constraint is the pragmatic_synthesis instantiation of the bitcoin_consensus_kernel; how do the maximalist_reading and utility_reading instantiations differ structurally?
omegas.resolution_mechanism: Compare the sibling stories' epsilon referents and victim sets once authored: maximalism authors the same frozen base as an eternal covenant (claimed naturality, no sunset, dissent treated as violation — expect higher suppression and false-summit exposure); the utility reading authors the base as a minimum viable substrate (perpetual iterability, wider accessibility, a different beneficiary set).
omegas.impact: Classification diverges across readings: maximalism trends toward mountain-claim and false-summit detection, the utility reading toward rope, this reading toward scaffold; cross-reading comparison isolates how much of each verdict comes from the arrangement itself versus the reading's interpretive frame.
omegas.description: Committer-structure routing: one kernel, three structurally distinct constraints.

omegas.question: Is the custody and channel risk borne by layer-two users attributable to the frozen base, or is it ordinary early-technology risk they would face regardless?
omegas.resolution_mechanism: Compare risk classes across chains: where base-layer primitives that eliminate a risk class (e.g., covenant-based vaults) exist on rival chains but remain blocked on bitcoin, the residual risk on bitcoin is attributable to the freeze.
omegas.impact: Attribution to the freeze raises effective extraction on the layer_two_risk_bearers seat and strengthens the payer designation; attribution to technology maturity keeps their burden as ordinary adoption cost with negligible effect on classification.
omegas.description: Attribution of layer-two user risk to the frozen base versus technology maturity.

omegas.question: Is the maintainer class's definitional authority over what counts as a kernel violation a neutral coordination function, or a gate that filters proposals by proposer affiliation?
omegas.resolution_mechanism: Audit merged versus rejected proposals against articulated criteria over time; test correlation between acceptance and proposer faction, employer, or prior alignment.
omegas.impact: Correlated gatekeeping converts the authority layer into an extraction vector (definitional rents), pushing the arrangement toward tangled_rope; uncorrelated gatekeeping supports the coordination reading.
omegas.description: Whether kernel-boundary adjudication is neutral or faction-filtered.

omegas.question: Does the availability of exit (forking, asset rotation) make the arrangement's persistence consensual rather than coerced — is the measured suppression structural lock-in or revealed preference?
omegas.resolution_mechanism: Assess realized fork survival and asset portability: the 2017 large-block fork is the natural experiment; track its sustained hashpower, valuation, and developer attrition against the parent chain.
omegas.impact: High exit viability discounts suppression toward revealed preference and supports the low-coercion reading; demonstrated exit failure through network-effect entrapment confirms structural suppression and raises the constraint's coercive floor.
omegas.description: Whether exit options are real enough to convert suppression into consent.

stakeholders.name: bitcoin_core_maintainers
stakeholders.situation: Hold commit access to the consensus-critical client and chair the review process that decides which proposed rule changes ship. Their merge decisions operationalize where the frozen zone ends: proposals touching issuance or supply are refused categorically, while uncontroversial technical upgrades can proceed through multi-year signaling. They absorb sustained harassment, legal-threat exposure, and factional blame for every refused change, while collecting the standing influence that comes with being the last gate. Leaving the role means abandoning the project their professional lives are built around.

stakeholders.name: full_node_operators
stakeholders.situation: Run independent validation of every block against fixed rules. Individually they change nothing; collectively their refusal to adopt altered rules is what makes the frozen zone binding — the 2017 episode showed user-activated refusal outlasting miner and business preferences for larger blocks. They gain verification sovereignty and freedom from trusted third parties, at the cost of maintaining hardware and upgrading on the community's schedule. They can stop validating or run rival software whenever they choose.

stakeholders.name: institutional_btc_holders
stakeholders.situation: Funds, custodians, and corporate treasuries holding large positions whose investment case rests on the supply schedule never changing. They receive the certainty dividend directly: no committee can dilute the asset they hold. Their exposure is financial and reversible — positions can be rotated into other assets at market prices — and they take no role in operating or governing the protocol.

stakeholders.name: retail_conviction_holders
stakeholders.situation: Individual long-term holders whose ownership is fused with a worldview about sound money; for many, selling would be self-negation rather than portfolio adjustment. They receive the same certainty dividend as institutions and additionally supply the cultural enforcement — social sanction against proposals framed as betrayals — that keeps the frozen zone politically untouchable.

stakeholders.name: bitcoin_miners
stakeholders.situation: Operate specialized hardware whose resale value outside this chain is near zero, tying their capital to the current rule set. They benefit from the untouched issuance schedule and from predictable rules that protect equipment investments, and they pay through a deliberately constrained block space that forces fee-market competition for inclusion; their 2017 preference for larger blocks was overridden. Moving to another chain would strand their hardware.

stakeholders.name: second_layer_developers
stakeholders.situation: Build payment channels, sidechains, and other systems above the frozen base, where deployment needs no global consensus — only the willingness of counterparties to opt in. The arrangement gives them a laboratory: they iterate without waiting for, or risking, base-layer agreement. Their skills and codebases port to other chains, so their attachment is professional rather than captive.

stakeholders.name: base_layer_improvement_advocates
stakeholders.situation: Engineers and users who wanted the base itself to carry more capability — greater transaction throughput historically; richer scripting, covenants, or drivechains presently. Their proposals meet the review process's presumption against change and have been refused repeatedly, in several cases after years of work. Contributing to rival chains remains possible, but leaving means abandoning the network and user base their work targets.

stakeholders.name: layer_two_risk_bearers
stakeholders.situation: Users who transact through payment channels and other upper-layer systems because base-layer capacity and features are limited. They receive faster and cheaper payments than the base can offer, and they bear the corresponding maturity risks: channel management errors, watchtower reliance, custodial intermediaries where self-management is impractical. Practical exit is limited by network effects — merchants, liquidity, and counterparties cluster on the incumbent stack.

stakeholders.name: ideological_maximalists
stakeholders.situation: Advocates who read the founding document as a covenant and won the outcome they demanded — the monetary core is untouched — yet lost the interpretive monopoly their reading required: upgrades they consider violations shipped anyway, and the ecosystem treats layering as normal. They retain full material freedom (self-custody, any software, any chain) and exercise voice constantly; what they cannot recover is a founding narrative that the whole project still honors.

stakeholders.name: forked_large_block_community
stakeholders.situation: Participants who backed larger base blocks, lost the 2017 contest, and continued their program on a minority fork. They hold a complete answer to the question the incumbents deferred — their chain does evolve its base — and their absence from the mainline conversation is itself a fact about the mainline: the surviving polity is pre-selected for acceptance of the frozen core.

stakeholders.name: independent_protocol_researchers
stakeholders.situation: Academic and independent analysts who study the governance record, model incentive structures, and publish critiques without holding commit access, capital positions sized to matter, or factional allegiance. Their seat confers no say; their output informs every other seat's self-understanding.

six_questions.coordination_function: Partitions protocol evolution into a frozen monetary core and an open application space, solving the credible-evolution problem: how an open-source monetary network can change without destroying the predictability that makes its unit valuable. Coordination is achieved by consensus-rule stasis below the boundary and permissionless experimentation above it.
six_questions.transfer_function: Transfers almost no value directly. What moves is decision rights and risk: certainty of supply flows to holders; experimentation rights flow to layer builders; upgrade risk is pushed onto layer-two participants; the opportunity cost of unbuilt base-layer features falls on the users who needed them. No seat collects a recurring transfer extracted from another.
six_questions.absent_voices: Future adopters who will inherit today's frozen trade-offs (privacy deficits, constrained throughput) have no seat; users priced out during the 2017 fee spike largely never returned; compliance-seeking financial intermediaries lobby from outside the governance perimeter. Participation requires running infrastructure and absorbing political costs, which selects the polity for the already-invested — the forked large-block constituency (authored here as an excluded stakeholder) is the clearest missing voice.
six_questions.disappearance_rationale: Overnight dissolution of the freeze-and-layer segregation would force simultaneous resolution of every deferred dispute: either the base becomes mutable and the monetary premium reprices against policy uncertainty as holders rotate out, or the layers lose their protected space and payment capacity collapses. The settlement/payments/experimentation division of labor that the ecosystem's institutions are built around would unravel within months.
six_questions.founding_problem: The 2015-2017 scaling-and-evolution crisis: transaction demand outran base-layer capacity while the community fractured over whether to enlarge blocks at the base, delegate scale to upper layers, or both — with network fracture as the standing risk throughout.
six_questions.founding_problem_corroboration: Contemporaneous records outside any camp's control — developer mailing-list archives, the New York Agreement signatories' statements, Hong Kong roundtable minutes — attest that the crisis occurred. The forked large-block constituency attests the problem was real and the layered resolution a defeat of their program; academic governance retrospectives corroborate the sequence from outside the beneficiary set. Whether the founding problem is solved, versus perpetually reincarnating in each new feature dispute, is disputed along the same fault lines as the kernel readings themselves.

network.dual_formulation_note: The colloquial label 'Bitcoin's consensus rules' decomposes into three structurally distinct constraints — one per declared reading of the bitcoin_consensus_kernel. Each reading instantiates a different epsilon over the shared referent (the standing arrangement of fixed monetary parameters plus layered growth): maximalism authors the frozen base as eternal covenant (naturality claimed, no sunset, dissent as violation), the utility reading authors the base as minimum-viable substrate (perpetual iterability), and this story authors it as provisionally frozen with delegated innovation space. Upstream/downstream influence flows through the shared enforcement machinery — node validation plus maintainer gatekeeping — which all three readings inhabit but evaluate differently.

commentary.narrative_context: A dominant open-source monetary network froze its consensus-critical monetary rules while delegating technical experimentation to systems layered above the base ledger. This story authors that arrangement as the pragmatic_synthesis reading of the bitcoin_consensus_kernel: the base layer's supply schedule and issuance are treated as untouchable, everything above the boundary is permissionless, and the boundary itself is administered rather than discovered. KEY AGENTS (by structural relationship): - bitcoin_core_maintainers: agenda setter (institutional/identity_locked) — administer the kernel boundary; - full_node_operators: enforcement base and beneficiary (organized/mobile) — their collective refusal makes the freeze binding; - institutional_btc_holders: primary beneficiary (powerful/arbitrage) — monetary certainty underwrites their thesis; - retail_conviction_holders: identity-fused beneficiaries (moderate/identity_locked) — cultural enforcement of the freeze; - bitcoin_miners: dual-positioned (organized/trapped) — subsidized by frozen issuance, taxed by constrained blocks, locked by stranded capital; - second_layer_developers: beneficiaries of the protected sandbox (organized/mobile); - base_layer_improvement_advocates and layer_two_risk_bearers: payers (moderate/constrained) — bear foreclosed improvements and displaced upgrade risk; - ideological_maximalists: beneficiaries with an unresolved grievance (organized/identity_locked) — they received the frozen core and lost the covenant; - forked_large_block_community: excluded (moderate/mobile); - independent_protocol_researchers: analytical observer (analytical/analytical). The claimed type is authored independently of the metrics: the arrangement reads as scaffold — a deliberate moratorium with an implied, never-calendared endpoint — while the metrics describe its actual operation, including the concentrated burdens its payer seats carry. Where the engine's computed types diverge from this claim, that divergence is the datum.
commentary.logic_rationale: Extractiveness 0.22: the referent is the standing arrangement — frozen monetary core plus sanctioned layers — assessed by this reading's own lights, which endorse the design; the residual score reflects concentrated cost-bearing (foreclosed base-layer improvements, maturity risk pushed onto layer-two users) plus the definitional authority the maintainer seat collects. Suppression 0.38 is authored as a raw structural property and is not scaled by power or scope — only the engine scales extractiveness, by directionality and spatial scope: the arrangement forecloses base-layer amendment near-completely inside the system while leaving external alternatives (forks, rival chains) fully open, which caps coercive intensity. Theater 0.12: the freeze and the layers both perform their real functions; the ritual share is covenant-liturgy rhetoric in governance debates. Accessibility_collapse 0.62: once the arrangement is understood, the alternative of changing base rules collapses as a practical option — every contentious attempt since 2017 failed — while meta-alternatives outside the system persist, keeping the score short of natural-law levels. Resistance 0.52: sustained two-flank pressure, maximalist purity politics on one side and utility-camp agitation for covenants and drivechains on the other. The three measurement series share one six-point grid (2009, 2012, 2015, 2017, 2021, 2025) so every metric is authored at every examined time point; extractiveness and theater rise into the 2017 resolution and settle lower afterward, while suppression_requirement traces the enforcement arc — machinery built through the civil war to a 2017 peak, then relaxing as the fork exodus removed organized opposition and the anti-change norm internalized. That hump is a crisis arc, not an oscillation; the oscillation-driven intermittent-reinforcement concern does not apply. Receipt surface authored affirmatively: each named seat was checked for capture of the arrangement's gains — holders receive positional certainty rather than transferred value, developers earn returns on their own effort, no seat collects the minimal extraction — hence 'diffuse'; fixing_cost is 'prohibitive' because the post-2017 record demonstrates that unfreezing costs the governing coalition more than any seat gains from removal. The prohibitive-plus-diffuse cell is piton-flavored, but the arrangement is not degraded: its function is live, enforcement is real, and theater is low — the cell here marks an entrenched transitional design, not an abandoned one.
commentary.perspectival_gap: The same architecture is experienced as four different things. From the maintainer seat it is prudent engineering: a review process protecting a system too valuable to gamble with. From the payer seats it is a ceiling: improvement advocates meet a standing presumption against their life's work, and layer-two users absorb risks that base-layer features would retire. From the maximalist seat it is a betrayal that kept the important part: they received the frozen core and lost the covenant. From the institutional-holder seat it is invisible infrastructure: a supply schedule that simply never changes. Same-level differentiation is driven by exit structure rather than nominal power: miners and node operators hold similar organized standing, but miners' stranded-capital exposure traps them to the chain while operators walk freely; maintainers and researchers hold similar informational standing, but maintainers are fused to the stewardship role while researchers rotate topics at will.
commentary.directionality_logic: Beneficiary declarations (node operators, both holder cohorts, layer-two developers, miners, maximalists) derive low directionality — the arrangement subsidizes them. Victim declarations (base_layer_improvement_advocates, layer_two_risk_bearers) derive high directionality and compute the hottest effective-extraction seats, amplified by constrained exit. Miners appear in both arrays: their dual position nets to intermediate directionality, pulled further toward the target end by trapped exit — ASIC capital cannot migrate. The maintainer seat sits in neither array, so the derivation would fall back to a generic institutional default that misses the dual reality of collected definitional authority and absorbed personal cost; the directionality_overrides entry corrects the institutional atom to 0.45, mildly net-beneficiary, and is the only override because no other seat in this story shares that atom. Researchers hold the analytical atom and sit outside the directional pull. Gain-flow receipt was checked per seat before authoring 'diffuse': nothing the arrangement extracts accrues to any named seat.
commentary.mandatrophy_analysis: The classification work here is keeping three mislabels apart. Reading the arrangement as pure coordination would erase the payer seats — the victims declaration keeps foreclosed improvement programs and displaced upgrade risk visible inside an otherwise genuinely cooperative design. Reading it as extraction would mistake cost allocation for rent collection: no seat collects transfers, which the per-seat receipt check confirms. Reading it as a steady-state rope would miss the temporality that defines it — the arrangement justifies itself as a moratorium, which is why the scaffold claim, the sunset flag, and the drift_state all encode conditionality. Mandatrophy is not resolved: the founding function still operates. But the drift_state records practice_drift — substantial and unacknowledged: the 'provisional' half of the frame is quietly atrophying while the freeze half hardens — and the moratorium_reversibility omega instruments exactly the question that separates a living scaffold from a scaffold converting, unadmitted, into permanent structure.
commentary.kernel_context: One reading of the bitcoin_consensus_kernel, whose fixed text is the founding whitepaper. This file instantiates the pragmatic_synthesis reading: base-layer monetary rules are immutable, upper layers carry innovation, and the kernel boundary is drawn between them. Sibling readings: the maximalist_reading, which reads the whitepaper as an eternal covenant such that any change violates it, and the utility_reading, which reads it as a minimum viable consensus mechanism enabling perpetual iterative improvement. This reading occupies the negotiated middle — inheriting the maximalist freeze for the monetary core and the utility camp's openness for everything above it — and pays for the compromise with a contestable boundary and an eroding 'provisional' qualifier. The foreclosure edge toward maximalism is strict: a framework that blesses SegWit- and Taproot-class changes cannot simultaneously hold that any consensus change violates the covenant. The edge toward the utility reading is coexistence: both readings remain live positions, disputing where the line sits rather than negating each other's premises.
